alt: AT&T Stadium interior entirely bathed in pink-purple glow from 18 LED grow lights suspended above a green grass soccer field
story: AT&T Stadium — a billion-dollar indoor NFL dome in Arlington, Texas — installed 18 pink LED grow lights suspended from the ceiling and shipped Colorado-grown grass 800 miles to North Texas, raising the entire playing surface 24 inches above the concrete floor, all because FIFA insists on natural turf for World Cup matches.
why_funny: They built a magnificent roofed stadium and then had to construct a full-scale greenhouse inside it to host a sport that normally happens outdoors.
